text: Agile methodology is a popular way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, which usually last two to four weeks. Each sprint focuses on a small set of tasks from a prioritized list called a backlog. Work is broken down into user stories, which describe a feature from the perspective of the end user. Every day, the team holds a quick standup meeting to share progress and discuss any problems. This iterative development approach allows for regular feedback, so the product improves step by step and can adapt to changing needs.
